question: Who among the following won a Padma Vibhushan award in year 1971?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Uday Shankar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uday Shankar **was an** Indian dancer and choreographer.**
 
• He is well renowned for **infusing elements of Indian classical, folk, and tribal dance** into a fusion dance style by adopting** European theatrical techniques** to Indian classical dance.
 
• He received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** in **1962 f**or his lifetime achievements.
 
• He received the **Padma Vibhushan** from the Indian government, in **1971.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4b6fee9361870c86f61d75a010bfc0fcb0017f173bd6fae930123e9df5a190c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajee Narayan:**

 
 
• **Bharatanatyam dancer, pianist, and composer **Rajee Narayan resided in Mumbai, India.
 
• **Sangeeta Shastra Mala **is a book she published that covers the** fundamentals of Carnatic music.**
 
 
 
• **Devjani Chaliha:**
 
 
• In addition to teaching at** Rabindra Bharati University, **Debjani Chaliha is a **Manipuri dancer.**
